messages.subject: bug? color/colour oversight
parts:
After calling
p <- qplot(mpg, wt, data = mtcars, color = cyl)

then
p + labs(color = "Cylinders")
does not work for me but this does work:
p + labs(colour = "Cylinders")

I presume this is a color/colour instance that Hadley overlooked when
trying to ensure everything takes both American and Anglo spelling.
